chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Salama ibn al-Khattab, from Ali ibn al-Hasan, from Ali ibn Abi Hamza and Muhammad ibn Ziyad, from Abu Baseer, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

When the woman menstruates while she is performing Tawaf by the House or between As-Safa and Al-Marwa, if she has passed the half, she should mark that place. So when she becomes pure, she returns and completes the remainder of her Tawaf from the place which she marked. If she cut off her Tawaf in less than the half, then upon her is that she resumes the Tawaf from its beginning.

key_terms.الصَّفَا وَ الْمَرْوَة: As-Safa and Al-Marwa (the two hills between which pilgrims walk during Sa'i)
key_terms.النِّصْف: The half (referring to half of the required circuits)

ai.seo_question: What should a woman do with her Tawaf if she starts menstruating during Hajj?
ai.summary: This ruling from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) establishes the principle of 'half-completion' in Hajj rituals, reflecting the juristic consensus that validity is preserved once the majority of the circuit is performed. It highlights the practical flexibility in Shia fiqh, allowing the pilgrim to resume from the marked spot rather than restarting, thereby minimizing hardship during the sacred rites.

en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Salma Bin Al Khattab, from Ali Bin Al Hassan, from Ali Bin Abu Hamza and Muhammad Bin Ziyad, from Abu Baseer, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘When the woman menstruates and it is during the Tawaaf by the House (Kabah) or between Al-Safa and Al-Marwa, so if she exceeds the half (circuits), she should mark that place. So when she becomes pure, she can return and complete the remainder of her Tawaaf from the place which she had marked. So if she cuts off her Tawaaf in less than the half (circuits), then upon her would be that she resumes the Tawaaf from its beginning’.
en.sarwar: 2. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Salmah ibn al-Khattab from Ali ibn al-Hassan from Ali ibn abu Hamzah and Muhammad ibn Ziyad from abu Basir who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘

If a woman experiences Hayd (menses) when performing Tawaf or Sa‘y between al-Safa’ and al-Marwah and begins to experience Hayd (menses) after passing half of Tawaf, she marks that point. After becoming clean she can return to that place and continue to complete the remaining part of Tawaf; but if experiencing Hayd (menses) begins before half of Tawaf is complete, she must do her Tawaf all over again.’”
